newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Merchants Hai Hong in share issue.
newsitem.headline: China Merchants Hai Hong in share issue.

text.p: China Merchants Hai Hong Holdings Co Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to issue 141.22 million new shares to its holding company China Merchants Union (BVI) Ltd raising net proceeds of about HK$446.6 million.

The company said in a statement that China Merchants Union had also agreed to place 74.21 million existing shares at HK$3.20 per share to professional investors. The subscription price for the new shares will be equivalent to the net price paid to China Merchants Union for the placement shares.
China Merchants Hai Hong said net proceeds of the new issue would be used for working capital and investment opportunities.
The placement shares represent about 10.5 percent of China Merchants Hai Hong's existing share capital and the new shares represent about 20 percent, the company said.
Following the transactions, China Merchants Union and its associates will hold about 60 percent of China Merchants Hai Hong's issued share capital, down from 62.5 percent.
China Merchants Hai Hong shares closed at HK$3.50 on Thursday.
